title: OpenAI's 10,000 AI agents solve 90-year-old maths problem; NYU prof says it cheated
content: OpenAI says an unreleased AI model has solved the Navier-Stokes existence and smoothness problem, a 90-year-old Millennium Prize question, using roughly 10,000 AI agents in 88 hours. The claim is shadowed by NYU professor Tristan Buckmaster, who says OpenAI took up his unpublished route after months of his drafts went into Codex. OpenAI denies accessing user data but cannot rule out that de-identified training data helped improve its models.

title: Delhi building collapse: PG operator Sudhanshu arrested

The nearly thirty-year-old structure's failure instigated an extensive rescue effort. Authorities are scrutinizing the family's connection and recent renovations conducted in the basement. Amid the ongoing investigation, five MCD officials have been suspended, and the High Court has raised concerns about safety in PG accommodations, ordering a comprehensive audit.

title: Uber's layoff memo also has a work from home message for remaining 29,000 employees

Uber is ending work from home for all but 1% of employees, asking remote staff to move to an office near their team. The three-day hybrid policy stays, and Uber will enforce it, with global teams concentrated in New York and San Francisco.

title: 4,000 NYC students plant 100,000 beachgrass stalks to protect 50,000 people

Since 2022, students, teachers and community members have planted more than 100,000 American beachgrass culms across 2.25 acres. The project aims to stabilise dunes, reduce erosion and build flood protection for more than 50,000 people living near the park.

title: Researchers turn water-treatment waste into filter that removes 97% microplastics

title: Not just Nepal: How climate change puts European Alps under threat

This year, the Mont Blanc massif has witnessed more frequent rock collapses. Regions previously blanketed in snow are now experiencing rainfall, which disrupts the stability of the terrain. Towns like Chamonix-Mont-Blanc face a looming threat of potential mountain collapses.

content: PM Narendra Modi calls for India to set its own standards and protocols for cross-border payments and directly integrate its payment system with countries where Indian diaspora populations are large . he said the move could also reduce the cost of remittances, noting that Indians abroad send the largest volume of money home globally .

title: Over 1,000 flights cancelled as air traffic control glitch disrupts UK airports
content: more than 1,000 flights were canceled, according to flightradar24 . the issue was linked to its flight processing system . engineers were working to restore normal operations after the problem affected airports across the country . more than 65,000 passengers had been disrupted and it had canceled more than 50 scheduled flights .
